main.description: Insert a content-addressed blob (sha256 keyed). Idempotent — re-insert of same content returns existing hash. Large bytes tiered to B2; small bytes stored inline in vertex_repository_blob.

ownerDid.description: Owning Actor DID. Used for authorization scope; blobs themselves are globally deduplicated.

content.description: Blob bytes. Base64url-encoded on the wire. No size cap here — runtime tiers >16KB to B2.

mimeType.description: Optional hint used only for editor preview. Not part of the hash input.

tier.description: inline = stored in vertex_repository_blob.inline_text; r2 = vertex_repository_blob.bytes_ref

deduplicated.description: true if identical hash already existed (INSERT was no-op).

errors.name: UnauthorizedWriter
errors.description: Caller lacks write permission for ownerDid.

errors.name: SizeLimit
errors.description: Blob exceeds max configured byte size.
